component.name: Konjugate
component.summary: Graph-native simulation engine for engineering and digital twins

description.p: Konjugate is an open-source graph-native simulation engine for building composable engineering simulations and digital twins.

Rather than requiring users to manually assemble large system-level formulations, Konjugate represents systems as graphs of interconnected components. Components define their states and properties, while relationships define the equations governing how quantities are transported and transformed between them.
